title: Working version of rstrap
description:
This PR is tracking the work done to make the `rstrap_document()` format works with last **rmarkdown**. 
Aim is to solves #6, #2, #8, #7 to have a working prototype

It took me a while to get use to the tooling (sass, webpack, ...) and understand what was made. But I now get a working version for prototype.

Two main sides : 

## Building rstrap JS and CSS 

JS build happens with webpack. CSS build with sass. This required updates in both process. 

### JS

* On the JS side, Popper.js was missing to make things work. this is required for dropdown and tooltip in bootstrap. This is used in rmarkdown for navigation features (code download, show/hide).
* bs3compat JS dependency was missing - it is from the work in **bslib** to make things work with bootstrap 4. I did not look further and just trust Carson works for now. This was added in the bundle. At least to make tabs works.

### CSS

* bs3compat CSS was missing to make things work as `html_document()`. The required .scss source were added to build `rstrap.css` with sass. 


## R format

rstrap files are added through a HTML dependency. Currently to make the format work we do the following:

* We use `html_document()` in which we pass as extra_dependency this new one
* **bslib** is activated (`theme = list(version = 4)`) so that anything bootstrap related works in rmarkdown but ... 
* ... In the rstrap dependency we trick the dependency resolving to remove bootsrap and bs3compat from **bslib**'s bootstrap dependency so that we only get rstrap at the end which bundles everything. 
* bs3compat files were obtained by copying what is inside bslib installation folder 


This is the state for now.
